definitions.gloss: leader; commander; one who leads a group
definitions.explanation: A person who leads and unites a group, army, or organization, directing its members toward a common goal. Emphasizes the authority and ability to keep a group under control and moving together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{統率者|とうそつしゃ}だ。
⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{統率者|とうそつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: An army needs a strong commander.

examples.japanese: ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{信頼|しんらい}できる→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧{統率者|とうそつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: To pull a disorganized group together, the presence of a trustworthy leader is indispensable.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{統率|とうそつ}→統率：13868_tousotsu⟧ (leading, commanding) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to someone who leads and unifies a group, stressing the authority to keep it disciplined and moving together. More formal than everyday words for 'leader'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{統率者|とうそつしゃ}: an excellent leader
- ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{統率者|とうそつしゃ}: the commander of an army
- {統率力|とうそつりょく}: leadership; ability to command

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧: leader; guide — leads by teaching and directing; less about discipline
- ⟦{指揮官|しきかん}→指揮官：19069_shikikan⟧: commander (military) — the technical term for one who commands troops
